title: Financial Model

origin.publisher: Jones Lang LaSalle (model author), in a report by Foley & Lardner LLP for the State of Hawaii Department of Accounting and General Services and Stadium Authority; published by the State on alohastadium.hawaii.gov
origin.title: Aloha Development Model (Exhibit C to the Aloha Stadium Conceptual Redevelopment Report, February 23, 2017)
origin.clearance_note: Public government record: the State of Hawaii publishes the full Aloha Stadium Conceptual Redevelopment Report on its own alohastadium.hawaii.gov domain. Downloaded by script. The report's cover is marked 'Privileged and Confidential / Attorney-Client Communication' and every model page carries a 'Confidential' footer; these markings predate the State's own publication of the report and are left in place as printed. The source is 181 pages; this folder keeps 16 of them (source pages 160-175, Exhibit C, numbered 'Page 1 of 16' to 'Page 16 of 16'), split out with PyMuPDF. The Exhibit D cash flow projections (source pages 177-181, a different author's renovate-versus-rebuild comparison) were left out by operator decision, as was the Exhibit D slip sheet, which names an individual preparer. The kept pages carry no personal data, so no text was redacted. Document metadata, which named an individual author, was cleared.

notes: Features the office own-operate cash flow sheet (folder page 6, printed 'Page 6 of 16', source page 165), which follows one development from cost through debt to exit: total costs, the permanent loan's opening balance, the first-year debt service coverage ratio, the residual (exit) value and the owner's IRR. The request suggested page 165 and these five values (total costs, IRR, permanent loan beginning balance, a DSCR value, residual value); all five ground 'ok' on that page and shipped as asked. The request also flagged Exhibit D (source pages 177-181) as a possible addition; the operator chose Exhibit C only.
